policy: Strict read-only admission gate for Wingless, Yggdrasil and Mass original T14 outputs; no selection, dispatch, policy learning or promotion from provider-only source-verified receipts.
inputs: Separate exact source and provider-run identities; independently signed source-birth/custody, science classification, native complete cost, independent matched replicated transfer; negatives retained even when ineligible for positive admission

controls: unchanged frozen Dream-RSI/Pareto selector with exact identity
matched compute/RAM/query expenditures including optimizer training and evidence verification
independent science authority and custody signature verification

comparator_requirement: equal cost, prospective randomized independent opportunities with signed propensities; do not use already consumed T13 cases as prospective T14
created_for: T14 learned transfer without resource regression
historical_sources: T7-T13 already consumed; do not replay; WNS/YNS/MNS remain sealed
evidence_order: operator instruction > source-pinned qualified outcomes > this preregistration
execution: No run authorized by this file; native research authority and independent first-use custody remain required
engineering_scope: Append-only preregistration; no executable, workflow, source generator, bridge, accepted-ref or policy mutation
required_qualification: verify immutable parent and frozen blobs plus source generator/learner/control/harness identities
qualify source-birth provenance BEFORE original cohort construction
cached exact-key focused tests only if complete semantic identity matches
one final original end-to-end regression before any build, acceptance or promotion
record independent original Windows and Linux provider results and both positive and negative observations
